TxConfirmation

Syntax
void Rte_[<Partition>_]LdComCbkTxConfirmation (
CbkHandleIdType LdComUserCbkHandleId,

)

0xA7
Sync/Async
Synchronous
Reentrancy
Non Reentrant for same LdComUserCbkHandleId, otherwise Reentrant

has been transmitted

None

None

None

Description
The lower layer communication interface module confirms the transmission of a PDU, or the
failure to transmit a PDU.

⌈
void Rte_[<Partition>_]LdComCbkTxConfirmation (
IN CbkHandleIdType LdComUserCbkHandleId,
Std_ReturnType result
)
where <Partition> is the shortName of the EcucPartition referenced from
the RteLdComUserEcucPartitionRef parameter (see [ECUC_Rte_09210]) of the

It is configured in LdComUserModuleCnf :

(See
[ECUC_LdCom_00025])
is
set
to

COM_TX_CONFIRMATION
